items.title: 「吉考斯工业 × 艾尔登法环 黑夜君临」秋冬新款正式发售
items.summary: 大家好，欢迎光临吉考斯工业！ 天气渐渐转凉，今日我们带来两款以《艾尔登法环 黑夜君临中》的角色「追踪者」和「黑夜之魔利普拉」为主题的秋冬新品。恰逢双十一开门红活动开始，该系列商品发售将于今晚 20:00 与活动同步开启，

content.v: 大家好，欢迎光临吉考斯工业！
天气渐渐转凉，今日我们带来两款以《艾尔登法环 黑夜君临中》的角色「追踪者」和「黑夜之魔利普拉」为主题的秋冬新品。恰逢双十一开门红活动开始，该系列商品发售将于今晚 20:00 与活动同步开启，届时还可享受折扣优惠！
此外，曾在线下展出过的两款流沙摆件也将在今晚 20:00 可供购买。
「吉考斯工业 × 艾尔登法环 黑夜君临」追踪者提花毛衣
本款以追踪者的装备体系为核心，将渡夜者的视觉符号重新编织于针织结构之中。
衣身中央提取追踪者头盔的侧面飞翼轮廓作为主视觉，双袖融入狼纹图腾与绝招「袭击桩柱」发射装置的白描纹样，手肘位置点缀小盾牌印花，强化角色的追猎与战斗意象。衣摆则提取追踪者默认服装的符文纹样，延续交界地古老神秘的视觉语言。
衣身与袖身图案运用精致提花工艺，赋予织物丰富的纹理层次
肘部配有复古贴布设计，融合精密激光烧花，打造独特的立体肌理
「吉考斯工业 × 艾尔登法环 黑夜君临」黑夜之魔利普拉重磅拉链外套
本款以平衡律法的魔物利普拉（Libra）为核心意象，将其诡谲的恶魔商人与炼金术视觉语言融入帽衫设计。
胸前图案提取恶魔商人利普拉的形象，以简化轮廓呈现其神秘、不可窥探的气质。后背以利普拉标志性的炼金术天秤图腾为核心图案，象征交易、权衡与未知的力量。手臂及帽身则提取利普拉躯体内部的眼状符文，以重复、蔓延的方式构成具有异质感的纹理。整体以旧化质感与低饱和色调呈现，营造属于永夜之王的诡秘、腐朽与超自然氛围。
袖身、帽檐、后幅及前胸等多位置采用高精数码印花
门襟、袖口及下摆处施以手工成衣做旧/毁坏处理
采用成衣手工喷色做旧工艺。通过手工喷涂染料，在成衣表面呈现自然褪色、渐变与磨损的复古层次感。色彩依附于面料表层，经日常洗涤后色泽将随时间自然柔化，复古质感更显自然
「吉考斯工业 × 艾尔登法环 黑夜君临」复仇者肖像流沙摆件
本款流沙摆件尺寸为 100mm × 140mm，十分适合桌面放置。主体采用高透光亚克力封装，精密多层结构将复仇者的唯美肖像与白雾般的流沙完美融合。轻轻翻转，如雾气般的细腻沙粒缓缓倾泻，在轻盈流动间重新定格交界地的氛围与宿命感。
尺寸：100mm × 140mm
「吉考斯工业 × 艾尔登法环 黑夜君临」主视觉流沙摆件
本款流沙摆件同样采用 100mm × 140mm 尺寸，以标志性的主视觉图为核心，采用高透光亚克力与多层次结构呈现。翻转间，暗紫色细腻流沙如夜幕倾泻，更加烘托出游戏原画宏大而深邃的暗黑氛围。
尺寸：100mm × 140mm

items.title: 拒绝代餐，我做了自己的卡牌游戏！《恶魔召唤》正在参加 Steam 新品节
items.summary: 市场上各类卡牌游戏层出不穷，如果你想从已经习惯的卡牌套路中出来，想尝试不同的的策略博弈与极致爽感，那么这款正在参加新品节的《恶魔召唤》绝对不容错过！游戏 Demo 现已开放，欢迎大家尝试和支持！ <内嵌内容，请前往机核查

content.v: 市场上各类卡牌游戏层出不穷，如果你想从已经习惯的卡牌套路中出来，想尝试不同的的策略博弈与极致爽感，那么这款正在参加新品节的《恶魔召唤》绝对不容错过！游戏 Demo 现已开放，欢迎大家尝试和支持！
由伏特加加开发、GCORES PUBLISHING 机核发行负责的《恶魔召唤》是一款玩法新颖，通过绘制法阵，连接节点出牌的卡牌游戏！游戏包含“单机肉鸽爬塔”和“联机双人对战”两大核心模式，能够满足不同类型玩家的策略与竞技需求！
别具一格的肉鸽爬塔
单机PVE模式包含3个独立牌池，超过300张丰富卡牌以及40多位机制独特的强敌。牌池经过深度设计，灵活且令人惊喜的组合层出不穷，希望各位也能在游戏中探索属于自己风格的策略。
https://image.gcores.com/81bc000af34703ebff7379fe053fa2fc-999-562.gif
出牌不再是简单的“打出”，而是深度的“构建”。你需要通过连接节点绘制出法阵来释放法术，每一张卡牌所处的位置和连线的先后顺序，都会引发不同的反应。同时，牌组将自由分配至各个法阵节点，你可以提前了解未来的两张卡牌，进行更长远的布局。
https://image.gcores.com/2c4be2d5fa7b5740d96c9a376a6fb843-1280-720.gif
此外在增益方面，《恶魔召唤》采用了十分灵活的装备-药膏系统，装备不仅可以自由穿戴，还可以通过药膏修改装备触发的时机与数值。多余的战利品可随时出售换取资源，让你能针对不同机制的强敌打造专属套装，并在战前灵活切换。
https://image.gcores.com/744f4c9686ac38d34d2890f69d5aeb6a-1280-720.gif
此外，肉鸽爬塔游戏中带惩罚性的随机事件虽然增加了变数，却也常常带来令人沮丧的负面反馈。《恶魔召唤》路线中的所有随机事件与选项均以正向为主：既保留了高风险高收益的刺激博弈，也必定提供一个基础收益的保底选项。游戏中没有充满恶意的随机惩罚，玩家的每一次抉择都将带来切实的成长，让路线规划更加稳定可控。
https://image.gcores.com/78645d3b4294f3b905de1fb41cee1e53-1919-1079.png
共享卡牌的联机对战
除了保留单机 PVE 的深度构筑特色，《恶魔召唤》在联机 PVP 模式中进一步引入了极具博弈感的“共享法阵”机制！中央的法阵的六个节点中，虽然设置了敌我半区，两位玩家只能在自己半区的三个节点放置卡牌，双方都能利用所有节点打出自己的法术，并正常结算它的效果！你可以提前算计布下陷阱，也可以抓住破绽半路截胡！但小心，你的对手也随时可能反将一军。告别同质化对局，欢迎各位加入玩家群，实时与各位牌友约战！
https://image.gcores.com/354c186a0548ed2011cb414df6614d3d-1280-720.gif
游戏现已加入新品节，欢迎各位支持
《恶魔召唤》现已加入新品节，欢迎大家前往下载试玩 Demo！如果你喜欢这款游戏，请务必将它加入心愿单！此外，欢迎加入官方QQ群，在群内你可以第一时间匹配对局、反馈实战体验，与开发团队交流关于卡牌平衡与机制的建议！ 🎮 Steam 商店页面： https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075830/_/
欢迎关注游戏官方社媒： 官方QQ群: 487110648 小黑盒：恶魔召唤_伏特加加 Billbill: 伏特加加_恶魔召唤 Bilibili: 机核发行

content.v: Q-Games于10月20日开幕的Steam新品节期间，限时开放《PixelJunk Monsters 3》首个可玩试玩版。该作以《PixelJunk Monsters》系列20周年为契机推进开发，并在原有塔防玩法中加入Roguelike机制。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460863_743908_jpg_r.jpg
《PixelJunk Monsters 3》延续玩家亲自在战场上移动和建设防御塔的玩法。玩家需要在场地中奔跑，通过舞蹈动作建造塔楼，抵挡不断涌向据点的怪物群。
本作将Roguelike元素纳入塔防流程，旨在增强每局游戏的策略选择和重复游玩价值。开发方还强调了游戏的视觉表现，手绘美术将以4K分辨率呈现。
试玩版仅在Steam新品节期间限时开放，目前尚未公布明确的截止时刻。《PixelJunk Monsters 3》的正式版发行窗口也暂未公开。

items.title: 消息称《GTA6/侠盗猎车6》街道更窄车流更密并限制武器携带
items.summary: 记者杰森·施赖尔转述了《GTA6/侠盗猎车6》的部分开发细节：游戏街道从开发早期起便被设计得比《给他爱5》更窄，同时将容纳更密集的交通；武器携带数量也可能受到限制。这些信息来自施赖尔讲述参观Rockstar苏格兰总部经历

content.v: 记者杰森·施赖尔转述了《GTA6/ 侠盗猎车6 》的部分开发细节：游戏街道从开发早期起便被设计得比《给他爱5》更窄，同时将容纳更密集的交通；武器携带数量也可能受到限制。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460610_112579_jpg_r.jpg
这些信息来自施赖尔讲述参观Rockstar苏格兰总部经历的视频。艺术总监亚伦·加布特介绍，道路尺度与车流变化不只影响视觉效果，还会改变建筑密度、城市结构以及车辆移动方式。与洛圣都便于加速穿行的宽阔道路相比，新设计可能增加拥堵路段驾驶和警方追逐的压力，玩家需要更谨慎地选择路线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460613_375853_jpg_r.jpg
高级开发人员罗布·纳尔逊称，团队希望武器携带机制更接近《荒野大镖客：救赎2》。角色将无法随时带着数量近乎无限的武器，玩家需要根据当前情境选择装备。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460616_925193_jpg_r.jpg
团队一度担心，传统武器轮盘中的空位会不断提醒玩家哪些枪械无法随身携带。开发者为此花费数月、甚至可能数年测试其他菜单以及取消轮盘等方案，最终仍决定保留原有轮盘，同时限制可携装备。上述内容属于记者对工作室交流的转述，并非Rockstar官方公告，具体设计仍需等待官方资料或成品验证。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 格力学校开学！董明珠：关掉校内宰我学生的超市 太黑
items.summary: 格力学校开学！校长董明珠：关掉校内宰我学生的超市 太黑

content.v: 既然出任格力技工学校的校长，董明珠就打算切切实实担好这份管理者的责任，不会让办学变成走形式的噱头。
10月19日董明珠亲自现身格力技工学校的教学现场，给首届刚入学的新生上了开学后的第一堂课，全程没有讲空泛的大道理，所有内容都围绕学生的日常吃住展开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200941059044.jpg
她当场在课上宣布，要直接关掉格力技校校内的小卖部，原因是自己当天顺路逛校园的时候，发现小卖部里一个普通橘子居然要卖一块五，定价远超合理区间，摆明了是赚学生的差价。
这位新上任的校长还当场和所有学生喊话，要求大家每天都要把饭吃饱，养足状态拿出年轻人该有的精气神，不用在日常开销上为了几块钱的吃穿委屈自己。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200941276168.png
这所技工学校是格力电器全资创办的，本月刚刚正式完成开学流程，办学模式主打入校即入企、毕业就上岗，所有学生毕业之后都可以优先进入格力电器以及上下游产业链合作企业实习就业，首届一共招收了300名学生，董明珠亲自出任校长一职。

content.v: 《药屋少女的呢喃》第三季在Netflix上线地区有限，仍跻身该平台全球周榜前十。Netflix Tudum统计显示，本季在2026年10月5日至11日期间获得超过150万次观看，排名全球第九。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460510_946431_jpg_r.jpg
第三季目前仅通过Netflix在亚洲少数地区上线，美国等地区的Netflix片库只收录了第一季。在美国及其他多个市场，第三季主要由Crunchyroll按周更新。与同榜的《JOJO的奇妙冒险：飙马野郎》和《冰之城壁》第二季相比，该季受到的地区限制更为明显。
剧情承接第二季结尾，猫猫已经离开后宫，壬氏也不再以宦官身份管理后宫，转而以皇弟和月之君的身份承担皇室职责。第三季改编自轻小说第五卷，开篇以严重蝗灾引出潜在的粮食危机与饥荒风险，猫猫察觉异状后开始追查原因。
第三季采用分两部分播出的安排，后半部分计划于2027年4月开播。系列首部长篇电影则预定于同年12月在日本上映，其故事时间位于小说第四卷与第五卷之间。

补丁发布时，游戏多人模式尚未开放，单人战役则已通过抢先体验提供游玩，因此本次更新主要涉及战役内容。PS5端的下载体积约为700MB，Infinity Ward将其称为一次小型更新，官方说明未公布更多具体改动。
受《使命召唤》统一启动器的版本显示方式影响，部分玩家也可能看到这次补丁被标记为《使命召唤：黑色行动7》或《使命召唤：战争地带》的1.110更新。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460423_936893_jpg_r.jpg
部分玩家在安装补丁后报告称，战役会停留在标题画面的“Opening Menu”阶段，无法继续载入。截至消息发布时，Infinity Ward尚未确认或说明这一问题，也未公布追加修复的时间。目前相关情况仅来自部分玩家反馈，尚不能确定其影响范围。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《 ARC Raiders 》在“冰封足迹”更新、免费试玩周末及五折优惠同期展开后，全平台日活跃玩家据估算升至约170万，达到近六个月最高点。该峰值出现在10月12日免费试玩结束之后。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460410_778766_jpg_r.jpg
游戏于10月8日通过“冰封足迹”更新升至2.0版本，加入新地图、新武器和新型机甲等内容。同期折扣为游戏迄今力度最大的一次，价格下调50%至19.99美元。Alinea Analytics分析师Rhys Elliott的报告称，这些措施推动Steam玩家回流，也带动游戏在其他已上线平台复苏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460415_883965_jpg_r.jpg
报告估算，免费周末期间约有15万名新玩家进入游戏。试玩结束后的三天内，游戏又售出约15万份，带来约300万美元收入，且这一数字尚未计入微交易收入。
官方还在10月13日至20日开展PvE测试，以适应社区中较为友好的玩家互动倾向。执行制作人Aleksander Grøndal此前表示，团队不排斥长期将现有PvEvP体验划分为PvE和PvP区域，但这一方案目前尚未确定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 天猫官宣：今晚8点iPhone 18 Pro系列历史最低价！

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200938432887.png
iPhone 18 Pro国行256GB官方起售价为9999元，Pro Max为10999元，提供256GB、512GB、1TB、2TB四种存储与勃艮第酒红、冰川蓝、银色、黑色四种外观。
需要注意的是，优惠应该还是组合的方式，除了天猫300元平台券，还有叠加以旧换新至高500元补贴，合计优惠约800元，256GB基础款到手降至9199元起。
旧机估价随机型与成色浮动，不参加换新的用户仅能使用300元券，实际结算以页面为准。
根据第三方数据显示，iPhone 18 Pro系列双杯累计销量目前已经超过400万台，其中Pro Max在第41周单周单品国内激活接近90万台，刷新记录。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200938502305.jpg
从产品结构来看，大屏、大内存配置的iPhone 18 Pro Max占据绝对主力，出货量占比超过全系列总量的50%，消费者选择顶配版本的意愿强于往年新品发布周期。

另外，近期发布的安卓旗舰机型因关键零部件成本上升普遍提价，万元价位段内安卓顶配与iPhone Pro系列的价格差距明显收窄，客观上强化了苹果高端机型的价值感知。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200938599624.jpg
相当一部分原本倾向安卓顶配的用户转向新款iPhone，叠加高端消费群体对价格变动敏感度较低，共同支撑了持续激活量。

content.v: Hotta Studio与Perfect World宣布，《幻塔》将从10月20日起停止PS4版的支持和更新，届时玩家也无法再通过PS4登录游戏。此次调整仅涉及PS4客户端，PS5版仍将保持在线，游戏在主机平台上将转为仅支持PS5。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460173_580587_jpg_r.jpg
官方将这次调整归因于PS4平台的性能优化困难和应用容量限制。现有玩家的游戏进度可以延续至PS5版，此前尚未领取的物品也会保留，待玩家日后升级至PS5后仍可领取。
《幻塔》最初登陆PC和移动设备，随后于2023年进入PS4和PS5平台，采用免费游玩的MMORPG模式。该作目前在PlayStation Store积累了超过1.6万条用户评价，平均得分为3.71分，满分为5分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792460175_761207_jpg_r.jpg
部分负面评价提到账户被删除和程序错误，其中一些问题已经得到处理，另一些仍在修复。不少评价则认可游戏的核心玩法循环和故事。此次变化并非《幻塔》整体停服，也不代表PS5版将结束服务；10月20日后退役的是PS4客户端，玩家进度及待领取内容仍保留转移至PS5版的通道。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 曝RTX 6060恐迟到2029年！性能甚至可能不如PS6
items.summary: RTX 6060恐迟到2029年！性能甚至可能不如PS6

content.v: 据硬件爆料人KeplerL2透露，英伟达下一代RTX 60系列显卡中的入门级型号RTX 6060，可能要到2029年才会推出，而且其性能甚至可能无法达到索尼下一代主机PS6的水平。不过，这些信息目前都属于爆料，英伟达和索尼尚未公布相关产品的正式规格与发布时间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200935089400.jpg
KeplerL2表示，受持续的供应限制影响，英伟达可能推迟RTX 60系列低端显卡的发布。他指出，当显卡供应紧张时，英伟达往往会优先保障更高端产品，导致入门级型号的上市时间被大幅延后。因此，他认为RTX 6060很有可能要等到2029年才能面世，并怀疑其性能能否与PS6相匹敌。
作为对比，目前有关PS6性能的传闻，曾将其定位与AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT或NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti等显卡进行比较。不过，这些对比主要基于尚未证实的硬件信息，不能视为主机最终性能的可靠结论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200934218450.png
如果RTX 6060真的推迟至2029年发布，意味着玩家可能需要等待相当长的时间，才能迎来新一代主流价位显卡。对于预算有限、希望升级游戏设备的玩家而言，发布时间与价格或许比单纯的性能提升更值得关注。
另一方面，主机与PC显卡的性能也不能只看型号或理论算力。PS6的实际表现还取决于定制芯片、内存配置、系统优化以及游戏开发环境，而独立显卡则需要搭配其他PC硬件运行。因此，即便两者存在性能差距，也要等到官方规格和实际游戏测试公布后才能判断。

content.v: Riot Games公布2027及2028年《无畏契约》冠军巡回赛合作队伍名单。配合新的VCT赛制，美洲、EMEA、太平洋及中国赛区的合作队伍均由10支缩减至8支，未来两个赛季的固定参赛阵容随之调整。

content.v: 世嘉宣布，《异于天堂》现已公开系列剧情预告片第一部“小仓篇”。本作将于2027年1月15日发售。系列剧情预告片将为玩家介绍本作主角·大东真贯穿1915年至1965年，跨越五个时代、五座城市的人生轨迹，着重展现大东在不同时代、不同城市结识的人们，以及他所经历的种种转折。
https://image.gcores.com/839ab80f17e0452fadc561b0df560fd3-1109-624.jpeg
本次公开的是系列预告片的第一集。“小仓篇”讲述了在美国受到迫害的大东潜入商人奥尔菲斯的“幽灵船”前往日本的始末。大东在船上结识了将在日后与他成为挚友的另一位偷渡客，真城优。历经漫长航程，成功抵达小仓后，等待着他们的却是残酷的现实。此外，此篇中还描绘了大东与影响其人生的人们的相遇，以及成为策划人的契机。这些经历构筑起了大东在日本顽强生存的根基。
今后还将陆续公开更多聚焦大东人生的系列视频，讲述他在本作各座城市中的经历。敬请期待。
《STRANGER THAN HEAVEN》剧情简介 大东终于踏上了另一个“故乡”——日本的土地。他来到了坐拥世界一流钢铁厂的城市，福冈·小仓。钢铁为这座城市带来了源源不断的活力，然而大东在这里遭遇的歧视与迫害，却与他在美国时如出一辙。不过最大的区别是，他在这座城市里遇见了帮助自己、欢迎自己的人。也正是在这里，大东迈出了自己在日本的第一步。
角色介绍（第一部 小仓篇）
大东真 （演员：城田优）
https://image.gcores.com/c314234f02cd5be7a807eed570792656-754-424.jpeg
初来日本，饱受歧视与迫害时，大东被小仓·黑铁町的龙头老大八岛平吾所救。为了生存，同时也是为了报恩，大东决定加入八岛的旗下。
真城优 （演员：藤冈靛）
https://image.gcores.com/8dcedd07d30917bef5a455e118d78bcb-754-424.jpeg
抵达日本后，真城怀着对彼此未来的祝愿，与大东分道扬镳。他的境遇与大东同样凄惨，但凭自己过人的才能，为自己谋得了容身之处。
奥尔菲斯（演员：Snoop Dogg）
https://image.gcores.com/9492c347b57a437d58ebd50c25043631-754-424.jpeg
大东与真城潜入奥尔菲斯的船，刚刚抵达日本便脱身逃走，销声匿迹。然而，奥尔菲斯其实一直追踪着二人，并最终与他们再次相遇。奥尔菲斯看似想取他们的性命，实际上却另有目的。
松本多惠（演员：穗志萌香）
https://image.gcores.com/25546d8f9a6d95c633bfcb50756c4d22-755-424.jpeg
小仓·黑铁町某咖啡馆的女招待，同时也是被城里的大人物，大木包养的情妇。因为一些原因，结识了造访咖啡馆的大东，并热情地欢迎了他。
八岛平吾（演员：大冢明夫）
https://image.gcores.com/e27735728613bf858fa415f6b81e63e2-755-424.jpeg
黑铁町的龙头老大。帮助了走投无路的大东等人，结拜成为老大与小弟的关系后，提点帮助着大东。
畑冈正（演员：宇梶刚士）
https://image.gcores.com/6b9945ebaec09098d0bc4e86a26b2e46-754-424.jpeg
在黑铁町与八岛分庭抗礼的另一个大人物——大木的小弟。争强好胜，盯上了在八岛崭露头角的大东。
《STRANGER THAN HEAVEN》预约现已开启

content.v: 由《鬼泣4》制作人小林裕幸执导的新作《愚者不灭》媒体评价已正式解禁。外媒MonsterVine为本作打出2分（满分5分），评价相当严厉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200925477726.jpg
MonsterVine在评测中表示，评测者一开始真心想在这款游戏里找到乐趣：每次开局都希望战斗终于能进入高潮，每击败一个Boss都期待出现新机制，不必反复刷关卡直到等级够高、时间够用才能挑战下一个Boss；每次走进身体改造升级商店，都以为合适的装备会出现，让自己彻底统治冥界。但这一刻始终没有到来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200925552367.png
评测认为，《愚者不灭》虽然明显受到Roguelike类型启发，却没有真正吸收其精髓，而是把该类型的点子和机制搬过来，却不知道如何组装成有趣的体验。文章形容它像一个“彻底扫兴的弗兰肯斯坦”，乐于让玩家在冗长乏味的战役中蹒跚前行。
从这篇评测看，本作的主要问题集中在战斗缺乏推进感、Boss战后的成长期待落空、升级商店未能带来转机，以及Roguelike循环变成重复刷取而非乐趣来源。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200926077656.jpg
对于一款由知名制作人执导的新作来说，这样的媒体开局并不理想。目前本作M站评分也同样已经出炉，均分68分。

items.title: 曝《GTA6》武器轮盘被反复推倒重做：最终妥协了
items.summary: 曝《GTA6》武器轮盘被反复推倒重做：最终妥协了

content.v: 相关爆料，Rockstar Games在开发《GTA6》期间，曾围绕游戏中的武器切换系统展开了长达数年的反复尝试。彭博社记者杰森·施赖尔（Jason Schreier）透露，开发团队一度认为传统的武器轮盘会破坏游戏的沉浸感，因此尝试寻找更加真实的替代方案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200921536225.jpg
在《三男一狗》等系列作品中，玩家可以通过武器轮盘快速选择枪械和其他武器。这种设计操作直观，也方便玩家在激烈战斗中迅速切换装备。不过，Rockstar在《GTA6》开发过程中希望进一步强化真实感，认为轮盘式界面可能与游戏追求的沉浸式体验存在冲突。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200922038983.jpg
为此，开发团队尝试过托盘、网状布局等不同设计，希望找到更加符合游戏世界观的武器选择方式。然而，这些替代方案经历了数月乃至数年的反复调整，始终未能解决相关问题。经过多轮迭代后，Rockstar最终还是决定回归玩家熟悉的武器轮盘。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200922556173.jpg
据爆料，这段经历发生在《GTA6》开发较为艰难的时期，大致集中于2019年至2022年。对于一款规模庞大的开放世界游戏而言，武器选择看似只是一个小功能，却会直接影响战斗节奏、操作效率与整体体验。开发团队需要在真实感、易用性和游戏性之间找到平衡，任何看似微小的改动都可能引发大量调整。

items.title: 《使命召唤：现代战争 4》弹出窗口：DMZ 从未如此有趣
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Pop-Up: The DMZ Has Never Been This Much Fun

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/r6jr0379-1792459498578.jpeg

Having just returned to Oz from a review trip at Infinity Ward, I was in a pretty good position to judge how authentic (and fun) a Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Pop-Up Experience could be. As luck would have it, Sydney recently hosted just such a shenanigan for press, content creators, lucky Xbox Fan Fest attendees and there were some limited slots open to the public via registrations. I infiltrated it fully.

Let me bust out my Tac-map and give you a sitrep on how the organisers decided to… well, run DMZ (as in a recreation of a real Korean demilitarised zone). The result was a limited-time, MW4-themed mini-extravaganza built around a series of virtual and physical challenges. In next to no time, my objectives list was overflowing with around a dozen POIs to visit across the Carriageworks event space.
Think interactive games, hands-on MW4 Campaign gameplay, photo opps and prizes for the exceptionally skilled.

To be honest, I wasn’t sure if I would be among the exceptionally skilled. Working in my favour: I was one of only a handful of folks who’d already finished MW4 (and on its unlockable Realism difficulty, no less). Working against that massive headstart: 15 hours of jetlag and severe sleep deprivation.
It was a 50/50, comrades. I’d blitz this event or pass out mid military-themed Squid Game.

When about sixty of us were marched into the event, I was mighty impressed with the dank, smoke-machine-assisted scene that greeted me. The organisers had nailed the DMZ duality aesthetic of two vastly different Koreas fighting over the one peninsula. Entry required picking a side, North or South, and a razor wire fence bisected the space as a roving spotlight made sure nobody defected.

Better yet, upon selecting which Korea to go with, a decision facilitated by uniform-and attitude-appropriate personnel, I was issued a passport with tasks to complete. Call me a communist, but I chose the NK and, at the risk of being hunted down as a traitor later, I can detail my time spent in the North.
I’ll let my issued Military Passport give you the gist of what was expected of me:
“Congratulations. You have been selected to serve the Northern Command, an honour granted to very few and refused by NONE.
Across this territory you will find operations. All participation, success or failure, will be stamped in this permit. Every stamp is yours to keep. Every victory, however, belongs to the North.”

Being proactive, I elbowed through a small sea of comrades to skip past the minigames, ascend centre stage and smash out a COD MW4 Campaign mission. Easy stamp, right there, folks. Side bonus: I even got some of my exploits replayed up on a screen the size of Kim Jong Il’s home cinema setup (he was quite the movie buff).
With early dominance secured, not only for myself, but for the glorious North entire, I descended back down into the other activities.

Honestly, there were some pretty nifty things to do. Operation Crossfire had me donning some NVGs and disappearing into a pitch-black shipping container to “acquire a target”. Once the traitor had been found and dispensed with, I moseyed over to Contraband Sweep and located anti-government items under threat of a time limit (and possible firing squad execution).
Glowing from my victory, I went and got an official State Portrait, where I was informed that the North does not photograph happiness, only my resolve. I adjusted my smile accordingly.

The fun continued with me snooping around the space to find and secure Daily Truth propaganda documents. I also hunted down and confronted a (not-so) Covert Operative who was skulking about with a smug, democratic way about them that disgusted me to my very core. Upon confronting this Task Force 141 agitator, I seized their permit and uttered the codeword hidden within. His shame at discovery was palpable. The glorious North earned another stamp.

Before making my way to the Armoury to secure my booty, I infiltrated the South side to witness how life was for Capitalist hooligans. On account of the bile repeatedly rising up my throat while in their presence, I didn’t see everything these bourgeois delinquents got up to. I did, however, notice that they were earning their own stamps for defusing bombs with aid provided by troops in full kit.

What overwhelmingly was worth it, however, was attending this wonderful, MW4-themed side diversion. In case you haven’t read our review-in-progress yet, the general consensus (which includes me) is that the Campaign is quite a return to form for Infinity Ward.
Or, to put that more succinctly, the solo pillar of this sequel, and the pop-up event inspired by it, are stamp-worthy. And you can put that in your permit with confidence, comrade.
DMZ Early Access starts from 21 October for those who preorder - and the full game launches on 23 October in Australia .

items.title: 《足球经理27》功能详解博客公开，带来更具个性、更包容的专属体验
items.summary: ­­世嘉宣布，Sports Interactive工作室打造的经典足球俱乐部模拟经营游戏系列“足球经理（Football Manager）”全新作《足球经理27》（后文简称《FM27》）最新功能详解博客现已发布，深入介绍

content.v: ­­世嘉宣布，Sports Interactive工作室打造的经典足球俱乐部模拟经营游戏系列“足球经理（Football Manager）”全新作《足球经理27》（后文简称《FM27》）最新功能详解博客现已发布，深入介绍经理创建工具、生成球员及无障碍选项。《FM27》将于11月10日登陆 PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S、PC（Steam／Epic Games Store／Windows）、Mac及Netflix平台。
https://image.gcores.com/2d2fd2ade89d18e1cb3a8aa8092ed0b2-1028-580.png
《足球经理》是由世嘉与英国游戏工作室Sports Interactive共同打造的全球知名系列。从地方半职业球队到世界顶级豪门，玩家将作为俱乐部的全权主帅，带领球队攀登更高的巅峰，体验无与伦比的真实足球经营模拟。
功能详解
“经理创造工具”更新
“经理创建工具”将提供更丰富的身材类型、新增族裔选项以及面部特征和皮肤的更新。除此之外，胡须的细节表现也得到了提升。在《比赛日体验》深度解析中展示的发型物理效果提升也同样适用，赋予角色更多个性。
穿搭选择也得到了丰富。玩家可选毛线帽或棒球帽；游戏还提供了全新的衬衫与针织衫组合，并新增了围巾和手套作为全新配饰。借助重新引入的颜色选择器，玩家可以更加自由地精修自己的造型。此外，在职业生涯开始前最多可指定四个最喜爱俱乐部的功能也已回归。
多元包容与无障碍选项
在“经理创建工具”中，新增了创建“轮椅使用者形象经理”的功能。选择电动轮椅款式后，该设定将体现在游戏内从起始画面到比赛日过场动画的所有相关场景中。当赢得足球界的最高荣誉时，奖杯颁发台也经过了重新设计，以确保无障碍通行。 与此同时，无障碍设置也得到了改进。全游戏的字体大小均已加大，并新增了一项允许关闭用户界面动画的全新设置。
为新星们赋予更多个性
“生成球员”功能中的肤色、色彩呈现和发型都得到了改进，更具冲击力的镜头角度和照明让球员资料画面比以往更加清晰夺目。面部姿态和位置调整的幅度也更加丰富，无论是未来的巨星还是竞争对手的年轻球员，都展现出了更鲜明的个人特质。玩家将能以更丰富的多样性，探索以青训招募（Youth Intake）加入的新星们。

content.v: 黑客Gezine声称已经攻破PS5当前的14.10版系统，并展示了开发者菜单。相关破解方案目前尚未向公众发布，真实性、漏洞细节、适用机型及可复现性仍有待核验。

items.title: 禁赛30天！C罗列举百项荣誉申请减轻处罚:此前求重判
items.summary: 被禁赛30天！C罗列举近百项荣誉申请减轻处罚:此前求重罚

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200904323255.png
葡萄牙足协纪律委员会公布对C罗擅自退出国家队集训一事的纪律处罚决定， C罗被处以停赛30天、罚款255欧元的处罚 。裁决书显示， C罗在纪律调查过程中申请减轻处罚，列举了自己职业生涯取得的诸多成就和荣誉 ，葡萄牙足协纪律委员会最终认可了其中部分减轻处罚理由。
根据裁决书，C罗提出了四项减轻处罚理由： 本赛季及此前三个赛季没有纪律处罚记录、对足球运动作出重大贡献、获得重要体育荣誉，以及对查明案件事实作出决定性贡献 。
在国家队成就方面，C罗强调自己已代表葡萄牙国家队出战234场、打入146球，是男子国家队历史出场次数和进球数纪录保持者。他还曾173次以首发队长身份代表葡萄牙出战，是葡萄牙国家队历史上最年轻的队长，并帮助球队夺得2016年欧洲杯以及2019年、2025年两届欧国联冠军。

在团队荣誉方面，C罗列举了自己职业生涯获得的35座冠军奖杯，其中包括效力皇马期间的15冠（13/14、15/16、16/17、17/18赛季欧冠，14、16、17年世俱杯，14、17年欧超杯，11/12、16/17赛季西甲，10/11、13/14赛季国王杯，12、17年西超杯）、曼联时期的9冠（07/08赛季欧冠、08年世俱杯，06/07、07/08、08/09赛季英超，03/04赛季足总杯，05/06、08/09赛季联赛杯，07年社区盾）、尤文时期的5冠（18/19、19/20赛季意甲，20/21赛季意大利杯，19、21年意超杯）、葡萄牙国家队的3冠（16年欧洲杯、18/19赛季欧国联、24/25赛季欧国联）、利雅得胜利的2冠（25/26赛季沙特联、23年阿拉冠）以及葡萄牙体育时期的1冠（02年葡萄牙超级杯）。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200907061908.png
个人荣誉方面，C罗列举了5座金球奖、4座欧洲金靴奖、4次欧足联年度最佳球员等荣誉，以及葡萄牙足协授予的世纪最佳球员奖和葡萄牙国家颁发的荣誉勋章。
葡萄牙足协纪律委员会在裁决中指出，C罗拥有令人印象深刻的职业生涯，凭借自身成就成为足球运动以及葡萄牙国家队在世界范围内的象征。他取得的成就激励了全球各地的儿童和年轻球员，并对足球运动的国际推广以及葡萄牙国家形象的传播作出了重要贡献。
因此， 纪律委员会认可C罗没有纪律处罚记录、对足球作出重大贡献以及获得重要体育荣誉等减轻处罚情节 。不过，委员会认为C罗10月6日发布的公开声明并未对查明案件事实起到决定性作用，因此没有采纳这一减轻处罚理由。
此外，C罗于10月16日完整且无保留地承认全部被指控事实，使适用处罚范围进一步降低。最终，纪律委员会决定对C罗处以停赛30天、罚款255欧元的处罚，此前已经执行的19天预防性停赛可以抵扣。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200907149580.jpg
值得一提的是，此前C罗曾在国家队风波中向葡萄牙国民致歉，并表示希望作为队长得到重罚：“葡萄牙足协应该对我的这一行为作出评估和处罚。我认为，不应该有任何从轻处罚的理由。我并非普通一员，我是球队队长，这反而应该成为加重处罚的因素。”

items.title: 《追逐末日之光》参加 Steam 新品节，试玩版今日开放
items.summary: NEOWIZ 于今日宣布，由其发行、JINO Games 开发的叙事解谜冒险游戏《追逐末日之光》将参加 Steam 新品节（Steam Next Fest）。 Steam 新品节是全球 PC 游戏发行平台 Steam 举

content.v: NEOWIZ 于今日宣布，由其发行、JINO Games 开发的叙事解谜冒险游戏《追逐末日之光》将参加 Steam 新品节（Steam Next Fest）。
https://image.gcores.com/59e76ec99f089711a267f226ae713397-1265-798.png
Steam 新品节是全球 PC 游戏发行平台 Steam 举办的线上活动，玩家可在活动期间免费体验尚未发售的游戏试玩版。本届活动将于 10 月20 日至 27 日举行，活动期间所有玩家均可前往 Steam 免费体验《追逐末日之光》全新试玩版。试玩版支持韩语、英语与简体中文等十种语言，面向全球玩家开放。
https://image.gcores.com/fc9f30bc8d97b2efabbe7d4b5642ba61-1920-1080.jpg
本次试玩版在原版本基础上进行了全面优化。开发团队结合此前试玩版及 Beta 测试期间收集的玩家反馈，对谜题、探索、画面表现及操作手感等方面进行了调整，带来与此前版本不同的游玩体验。
本次的试玩版将更完整地呈现《追逐末日之光》独有的情感氛围：玩家将在既熟悉又陌生的首尔街景中展开探索，追寻其中人物的故事。随着新增剧情区域的开放，玩家也可以提前感受此前未揭晓的全新内容：
https://image.gcores.com/123cfeca230759effff05b312cb55e78-1920-1080.jpg
本次试玩版扩大了可游玩范围，并在新增区域中加入了部分全新谜题，使玩家可以更专注于探索场景与解谜的过程。
此外，游戏的视觉表现与叙事沉浸感也得到进一步提升。开发团队对部分背景、物件等美术元素进行了调整与完善，补充了场景细节与音效，并优化了操作体验与游玩便利性。在保留原有游玩节奏的基础上，玩家将能够探索更广阔的场景，进一步体验《追逐末日之光》的故事。
https://image.gcores.com/54c43736e30ee7172325e15e9b1e4c8f-1920-1080.jpg
与此同时，为庆祝参加本次 Steam 新品节，官方也首次公开了全新主视觉（Key Art）。
此次主视觉以游戏的核心舞台——首尔为背景，通过灾难过后的城市景象与人物的情绪表达，进一步展现了《追逐末日之光 》独有的世界观与情感氛围。
《追逐末日之光》是一款以近未来首尔为背景的叙事解谜冒险游戏。故事发生在即将面临小行星撞击的首尔，主角罗妍在追寻与太空避难计划有关的线索中不断寻找自我。游戏以 2.5D 像素美术呈现首尔街景，注重探索、环境解谜，以及人文叙事与故事讲述。
https://image.gcores.com/8643d3d18b1b79f43ba759499bd46df0-1920-1080.jpg
JINO Games 代表金镇浩表示："通过此前的 Beta 测试，我们了解到玩家在游玩过程中的实际感受，以及游戏中需要改进的部分。我们正根据大家提出的意见完善部分内容，并计划在正式发售前持续打磨游戏。"
他还表示："本次 Steam 新品节试玩版扩大了此前公开内容的可游玩范围，增加了新的游戏区域及部分全新谜题。希望体验过此前试玩版的玩家也能关注此次新增的内容。我们将全力以赴，争取在正式发售时以更加完善的作品与大家见面。"
《追逐末日之光》即将于 Steam 平台发售，玩家可前往 Steam 商店页面将游戏加入愿望单。

items.title: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》团队谈后续工作，配角Biddy意外走红
items.summary: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》获得积极评价和玩家反馈后，Fuse Games已将注意力放在发售后工作及未来内容上。首席执行官Matt Webster同时谈到配角Biddy Blas意外走红，其相关片段在社交媒体获得数百万次观看

content.v: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》获得积极评价和玩家反馈后，Fuse Games已将注意力放在发售后工作及未来内容上。首席执行官Matt Webster同时谈到配角Biddy Blas意外走红，其相关片段在社交媒体获得数百万次观看。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792457424_989272_jpg_r.jpg
Webster表示，团队原本知道Biddy和Hibi等角色可能受到玩家喜爱，但没有预料到社区会以如此规模接受并传播这些角色，部分玩家甚至开始引用赫特语。他称这种反响“很了不起”，并认为这体现了《星球大战》世界容纳非传统英雄和奇异外星角色的吸引力。
Biddy原本只是陪伴玩家参与巡回赛事的一组车手之一。对于该角色是否会推出商品，Webster表示决定权属于Lucasfilm；至于让其进入“银河边缘”主题园区，他仅表达了个人期待。
Webster还回顾了团队早期与Lucasfilm Games合作的经历，并介绍了游戏目前的表现和团队接下来的关注方向。虽然相关访谈标题提到DLC，但现有内容并未公布扩展包名称、具体内容、上线日期或定价，因此尚不能视为新DLC的正式公布。

items.title: 爆了！XBOX高管发表激进言论被玩家喷烂：账号已关
items.summary: 爆了！XBOX高管发表激进言论被玩家喷烂：账号已关闭

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200838565296.png
微软Xbox一名负责商业战略的高级经理布兰登·斯蒂拉普（Brandon Stirr​​ap），近日因公开力挺人工智能技术而陷入舆论风波。在社交媒体上发表多条争议言论后，他关闭了自己的社交账号。据PC Gamer报道，Xbox方面表示，他停用账号的原因是收到了大量回复和评论，但目前没有消息表明微软因此对他采取了内部纪律处分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200838337680.jpg
斯蒂拉普此前声称，游戏行业几乎是唯一一个假装没有使用人工智能的行业，并直言拒绝拥抱AI的开发者不应该继续留在这一行。他认为，AI工具将成为游戏开发的重要组成部分，工作室若迟迟不采用相关技术，就可能失去竞争力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200836455157.png
为了证明AI的效率，他还分享了自己借助AI智能体、通过所谓“氛围编程”制作游戏的经历。他声称，过去移植团队需要花费数月完成的工作，如今借助AI可能一个周末就能完成。不过，这一说法属于他个人的经验与判断，并不意味着所有游戏开发任务都能达到相同效率。
斯蒂拉普还表示，微软和Xbox在2026年已经使用AI技术，并称自己甚至可能因为这些言论丢掉工作，但愿意承担风险，希望Xbox员工不再对使用AI有所顾虑。

content.v: 彼得·杰克逊更新了两部《指环王》电影的制作进度。《指环王：猎捕咕噜》已接近完成拍摄，约剩两周工作；《指环王：往昔之影》目前仍处于剧本创作阶段。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792454278_305227_jpg_r.jpg
《指环王：猎捕咕噜》计划于2027年12月17日上映，拍摄结束后将转入下一制作阶段。影片设定在《指环王：护戒使者》开头跨越17年的时期，围绕甘道夫寻找咕噜展开。他需要赶在敌人之前找到咕噜，避免至尊魔戒的位置泄露。
这段故事取材自托尔金原著，但旧版电影对相关时间跨度的处理更像只有数月，新片如何与原三部曲衔接仍是关注点。
由斯蒂芬·科尔伯特参与主导的《指环王：往昔之影》尚未公布正式上映日期。影片计划交织两条叙事线：一条讲述《指环王：王者归来》事件结束多年后的山姆、梅里与皮平，属于新增内容；另一条将采用《护戒使者》原著中未被杰克逊旧版电影使用的章节。
扩展经典故事的做法已引起部分反对意见，不过两部作品仍不同程度地以托尔金文本为基础。目前可以确认的内容仅限制作进度及上述故事方向，最终剧本、演员安排和上映计划仍可能调整。

content.v: 《愚者不灭》以鲜明的千禧年代流行朋克美术和11种变身展现出丰富创意，但迟缓、容易落空的战斗削弱了整体体验。本作是GPTRACK50的首部作品，定于2026年10月21日登陆PC和PS5。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792454071_385946_jpg_r.jpg
故事主角戴维是一名脱离僵尸群体的少年。他需要挑战怪物，营救意外被冻在冰淇淋店冷库中的啦啦队女孩。主角服装、主题曲和菜单音乐录像均围绕朋克气质展开，过场与界面则采用马克笔涂鸦、贴纸及杂志剪贴元素，形成了较高的视觉辨识度。
游戏中的商场承担着类似《哈迪斯》据点的功能。玩家可在此购买升级，再通过抽水马桶进入地下城。战斗融合空中连击、评分机制和大量敌群，并以“愚蠢招架”与“风格吞噬”为核心：戴维主动冲向攻击时会承受可恢复的削减伤害，咬下精英敌人的核心后则可获得新的形态。
包含默认僵尸在内，游戏共有11种风格，狼人、吸血鬼和巫妖等形态均配有独立招式与随机特殊技能，变身设计也获得肯定。不过，多数形态移动迟缓，部分能力受冷却时间限制，缺少锁定还会导致攻击落空。敌人有时会长时间不动或直接冲过目标，招架与吞噬循环因此难以保持稳定。
评测者最终主要使用狼人、巫妖和吸血鬼，并开启强化模式加快重复段落。快速升级能够提供数值增长带来的即时满足，但关卡胜负过度依赖等级，丰富的设计未能转化为持续投入感。本次评价基于PC版，评测代码由发行方提供。

items.title: 由于人工智能主导的克隆猖獗，Moonlighter 工作室不会对其下一款游戏进行公开游戏测试：“我们知道我们不是唯一有这种感觉的开发者”
items.summary: ReVamp will get a limited Discord playtest.

content.v: The studio behind the Moonlighter series has announced it will no longer host a public playtest for its forthcoming roguelike due to fears it will be "reverse-engineered, cloned and published". The move comes as a surge in rapidly vibe coded clones floods Steam, Roblox and mobile app stores in the aftermath of Claude Opus 5.5.

"With launch still months away, sharing a build with tens of thousands of players feels like too big a risk," Digital Sun Games' marketing manager Israel Mallén told PC Gamer. The game under discussion is ReVamp , a "tower defensevania" roguelike due for release in March 2027.
"We know we're not the only developers feeling this way, and the more this is talked about, the more likely platforms are to step in."

In its public announcement Digital Sun Games was fairly blunt. "We've been concerned by recent news of games being reverse-engineered, cloned and published before the original is even out. With launch still months away, a large public build of ReVamp felt like too big a risk."

Last week the studio behind Drunken Goddess Reflux canceled plans to roll out a public demo for Steam Next Fest due to similar fears. "We're concerned the demo's content could be used to quickly imitate or replicate the game's presentation and gameplay with AI or other tools, and that such works could be released before launch," a spokesperson for the studio wrote.

Opus 5.5 has proven hugely disruptive to the games industry. It has aided several high profile game decompiles, helped jailbreak the PS5, led Xbox to announce its own AI-centric Xbox Labs , and made developing quickfire clones extremely easy. It's likely why this month's Steam Next Fest has over 8,000 demos , up from around 4,000 in June.

As I wrote yesterday, the speed at which clones can now be turned around is mind-boggling, and will have (is already having) huge ramifications for indie game development and marketing. When the creator of incremental punching game Escape the Walls published footage of their game on X, it was only ten days before at least seven clones were available on Roblox, and at least one on Steam.

items.title: 《塞尔达传说》百科全书今日在亚马逊发售
items.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda Encyclopedia Is on Sale at Amazon Today

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/legend-of-zelda-encyclopedia-1792447541948.png
本周，亚马逊推出了另一款买一送一的图书促销活动，其中包括精彩的《塞尔达传说百科全书》。这本精装书是送给视频游戏系列粉丝的绝佳礼物，最新的折扣让您可以为自己和朋友购买一本。
该百科全书最初于 2018 年出版，但一直是最受欢迎的《塞尔达传说》书籍之一。除了作为亚马逊 BOGO 促销活动的一部分外，它还以标价 45% 的价格出售。
值得注意的是，这本书在过去几年中持续畅销是有原因的。该百科全书仅探讨了《塞尔达传说》的前 30 年，这意味着它不包含《荒野之息》或《王国之泪》的信息。本书的时间线和数据库元素仅延伸到游戏的暮光公主时代。
话虽这么说，它仍然是现存唯一的百科全书版本。现在我们已经迎来了《塞尔达传说》的 40 周年纪念日，任天堂最终有可能推出包含最新游戏的更新版本，但目前尚未宣布任何消息。我们所知道的唯一一本即将推出的《塞尔达传说》书籍是《Zonai 的秘密》，要到 2027 年 3 月才会出版。
《塞尔达传说百科全书》是三本收藏书籍系列中的最新版本。除了本指南之外，还有《海拉尔历史》和《艺术与文物》，两者都深入探讨了更具体的历史信息。不幸的是，这两本书目前都不包含在亚马逊的销售中。
更多塞尔达传说书籍正在促销
由于获得额外 50% 折扣的唯一方法是购买亚马逊促销中包含的两本书，因此我继续拿出了其他一些著名的《塞尔达传说》书籍。首先是姬香晃的时之笛漫画。随着任天堂的《时之笛》重制版即将推出，官方漫画将是您收藏中的一个非常酷的补充。然而，由于促销方式的原因，与百科全书一起购买它只能额外节省 5 美元。
如果您想节省更多钱并为自己购买塞尔达传说的礼物，《荒野之息》和《王国之泪》指南是您的最佳选择。它们包含《塞尔达传说百科全书》所缺乏的信息，并且价格更相似。将百科全书与这两本书搭配使用，可确保您在促销活动中额外获得 11 美元的折扣。

content.v: ComicBook援引记者Jason Schreier提供的信息称，R星内部负责美术生产流程的团队，在开发《给他爱5》时约有5至6名成员，而《GTA6》相关团队如今约为65人，人员规模达到此前的十倍以上。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792448246_716131_jpg_r.jpg
这里所说的美术生产团队并非所有美术创作者的总和，而是负责让大量美术资产进入游戏、并确保这些内容得到有效组织和使用的生产部门。
随着游戏世界扩大、画面细节增加，项目需要处理的资产和协作环节都会上升，因此该团队的扩张可以作为制作规模与流程复杂度增加的迹象。
ComicBook推断，新作可能拥有更多细节并减少资产重复使用。本作将于11月19日登陆PS5和XSX，尚未公布PC版，首发时只有单人战役。

content.v: 近日前卡普空高管Miguel Corti回顾《 生化危机7 》开发过程，称该作早期方案经历数次调整。《最后的生还者》的成功让团队重新看到叙事驱动单人游戏的潜力，并间接推动项目强化剧情与 恐怖 体验。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792447223_833955_jpg_r.jpg
Corti表示团队当时不再像此前那样从《使命召唤》寻找方向，而是将注意力转向《最后生还者》。开发人员希望获得其他作品赢得的高度评价，尤其是其中不少作品本身明显受到《生化危机》影响。
按照Corti的回忆，当时构想的《生化危机7》不仅会更强调叙事，还计划加强与系列世界观及既有设定的联系。管理层对《生化危机6》市场表现非常满意，而项目改变方向的重要原因之一是开发团队希望在评价层面实现突破，并非简单否定前作成绩。
《使命召唤》僵尸模式在2010年代初已经形成规模可观的社区，一度成为亡灵题材体验的重要参照，但《最后生还者》推出后吸引了大量关注。最终问世的《生化危机7》采取了更集中、克制且偏重恐怖感的方向。

content.v: 英伟达为RTX40、RTX50系列显卡，推出全新DLSS帧生成性能模式，在小幅牺牲画质的前提下，最多可实现35%的帧率提升。该模式目前处于Beta测试阶段，在Nvidia App内的DLSS高级覆写设置中名为 Preset C(C 预设)。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792446925_779429_jpg_r.jpg
新模式采用全新算法替换原有光流AI模型，命名为帧生成‑性能模式。原有模式予以保留，改称为帧生成‑质量模式。官方表示Preset‑C对显卡资源占用更低，但画面质量会有轻微损耗。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792446925_820052_jpg_r.jpg
以RTX5060测试数据举例：
3倍帧生成：帧率从120FPS 提升至132FPS
6倍帧生成：帧率由255FPS 暴涨到348FPS
启用方式：更新Nvidia App，进入设置的DLSS覆写(Override)模型预设，帧生成选项选择Preset C即可。目前仅为Beta版本，第三方实际测试还有待验证英伟达给出的性能数据是否完全属实。

items.title: 《星球大战零连》增加了新的难度选项，可以使其更接近 XCOM
items.summary: Turning up the heat a little.

content.v: Star Wars Zero Company's 1.2 patch introduces a new granular difficulty system in addition to the usual bugfixes and tweaks. These new options exist alongside the original difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard, ironman beskarboy etc.), and home in on more creative/tactical tweaks, rather than just beefing up enemies. The highlights:

I like these options a lot: They're sharp, targeted changes that make Zero Company harder by restricting your options, forcing you to think and play more creatively. The game's normal, default difficulty, with all of these modifiers added, represents a more interesting challenge to me than the shipped hard mode, and I think my first replay will mix in a few of them. These options remind me of survival mode in an RPG, or skulls in Halo⁠—creative difficulty options that eschew ballooning enemy health bars just make me excited.

Zero Company goes down a lot smoother than the XCOMs of old (which much of the Bit Reactor team worked on). That smoothness isn't necessarily a bad thing, and I thought Zero Company already had a reasonable skill ceiling with the options it shipped with⁠—you can read more in my 90% review . But a modular suite means you can tweak pain points without taking the leap of a full difficulty level jump.

My friends and coworkers who thought Zero Company went down too smooth should be well-served by this update. The only classic tactics disconnect I see remaining is fog of war. PCG online editor Fraser Brown is a strategy connoisseur, and he felt let down by how Zero Company shows you the full map and locations of all enemies on every mission. XCOM, by contrast, would obscure portions of the map and enemy activity unless you were directly observing them.

I'm agnostic on the issue, myself⁠—I think Zero Company offers interesting tactical challenges regardless. This big patch is a nice win for developer Bit Reactor, which has reportedly started bringing back furloughed employees following the critical and apparent commercial success of Zero Company.

items.title: 卢卡斯影业希望制作更多《零连》和《银河赛车》等星球大战游戏：“我们已经尝试更加灵活地选择我们愿意接受的合作伙伴”
items.summary: Not every Star Wars game has to be a big-budget blockbuster to be successful.

content.v: We've had two Star Wars games in 2026, both of them quite good and neither of them quite what you might expect from the Star Wars mould: Zero Company , an XCOM-style tactics game, and Galactic Racer , an arcade racing game but Star Wars. And the success of those games means we may see more like them—which is to say, more offbeat Star Wars games from smaller-scale studios—in the future.

Both Zero Company and Galactic Racer were developed by independent studios—Bit Reactor and Fuse Games, respectively—and that "very much is part of the strategy," Lucasfilm Games vice president Douglas Reilly told The Game Business .

"Obviously, huge triple-A games like Battlefront are always going to be an essential part of the strategy," Reilly said. "But one of the great things about Star Wars is it has all kinds of other opportunities to tell stories in different genres.

"The goal has been to find the best partner who makes that experience come alive inside the galaxy far, far away. And it doesn’t have to always be triple-A, sometimes it can be double-A, and it’s really about the experience that we’re delivering and the fantasy we’re fulfilling."

That's a real shift in Disney's approach to making Star Wars games. Disney acquired Lucasfilm in 2012 and shuttered its games division the following year; not long after that, it signed a 10-year deal with Electronic Arts , granting it exclusive rights to make Star Wars games. That deal was not especially fruitful, and Ubisoft's big-budget Star Wars Outlaws , announced in the waning years of the EA deal, didn't exactly set the world on fire either.

Disney also resurrected Lucasfilm Games in 2021, making it "the official identity for all gaming titles from Lucasfilm"—which, as the sizzle reel made clear, meant Star Wars games—and it's "tried to be more flexible about who we’re willing to take pitches from," Reilly said.

"Good ideas can come from a lot of different places. You don’t have to necessarily be a top five publisher to make a great Star Wars game. There are some hurdles. We have a high quality bar, and that means typically we work with more experienced teams than ones with no track record. But we’re exploring all kinds of things, large and small, with partners that are going to surprise folks."

Of course, there are plenty of familiar-looking Star Wars games in the trench too: Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic , a new addition to the Knights of the Old Republic series, was announced at The Game Awards in 2025, the third and supposedly last Star Wars Jedi game is in development, Quantic Dream is still plugging away on Star Wars: Eclipse, despite recent reports of struggles , and yes, that KOTOR remake is, somehow, still happening .

items.title: 阿卡姆恐怖：重制预览和独家艺术展示
items.titleEn: Arkham Horror: Remastered Preview and Exclusive Art Reveal

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/arkham-horror-remastered-1792431674583.png

在我所有的爱好中，没有一件事是我对它感兴趣的“大爆炸”时刻。除了棋盘游戏之外，灵感的闪现是在 2008 年左右，我第一次玩 Fantasy Flight Games 出品的《阿卡姆恐怖》第二版。我最早的 Facebook 照片之一是我和我的朋友们围坐在我妈妈家的餐桌旁，我们的站立者面对克苏鲁的巨型卡片排成一排，进行最后的抵抗。现在，那个激发了我对这个爱好的热爱的版本又有望以《阿卡姆恐怖重制版》的形式回归，而其有助于使其成为现实的活动将在短短几天内在 Gamefound 上推出。 IGN 有机会与 Fantasy Flight Game 团队成员讨论了该项目，这是他们所谓的“Vault 系列”中的第一个项目。
这个备受喜爱的《阿卡姆恐怖》第二版的复活版本标志着 Fantasy Flight Games 称之为“Vault 系列”的首次发布。这项努力旨在将公司传奇积压的经典游戏带回并重新引入现代受众。以《阿卡姆》为例，洛夫克拉夫特式合作系列的这个版本已经绝版很多年了，从那时到现在，还有一个完全不同的第三版。

“Arkham Horror 2nd Edition is a cornerstone of the industry that paved the way for many modern gaming experiences. It’s a fan favorite that many people have affectionately called their first entrance into board gaming. It’s actually the first FFG board game I ever played,“ Wesley Mouri, FFG’s brand ambassador says. “Because it has been out of print for some time, we have seen a number of fans looking to complete their collections or eager to experience this classic title for the first time. Balancing those made it the perfect choice for our debut Vault Series title.”

For folks that have spent years wandering the streets of Arkham, closing interdimensional gates and shutting down the nefarious machinations of cultists and cosmic horrors in the 2nd Edition, Remastered will feel like coming home. In fact, the team’s goal is to make it a smoother experience to get new players into this world, taking lessons learned over the course of the past 15 years since the last expansion was released.

一直致力于更新《重制版》第二版的设计师 Dane Beltrami 是这样解释的：“许多规则都通过文字或图形设计进行了澄清。卡牌更清楚地说明了它们的作用，并且需要更少的维护/对其他规则的引用。也就是说，一些更大的事情确实发生了变化 - 例如将阿卡姆遭遇阶段和另一个世界遭遇阶段合并为一个遭遇阶段。总的来说，重点是让效果不依赖于其他规则。”你需要在整个游戏过程中经常查找东西。”戴恩继续说道：“这是通过让卡片更清楚地说明它们的作用，并利用直观的图形设计来提醒玩家在游戏过程中使用来实现的。其中一个例子是恐怖轨道被赋予了更清晰的图形设计，以便玩家知道在每个恐怖阈值时会发生什么。”
在设计和美术方面，《重制版》似乎采用了与 FFG 非常受欢迎且正在进行中的《阿卡姆恐怖：活生生卡牌游戏》类似的艺术风格，该游戏今年早些时候发布了自己的新核心系列，我们对此进行了评论。戴恩详细阐述了这一观察结果：“我们有意识地努力将《阿卡姆恐怖重制版》的外观与阿卡姆恐怖生活卡牌游戏所确立的当前美学统一起来。

As we have continued to develop the Arkham brand, we have seen the aesthetic evolve significantly. Our primary goal with this updated art direction is to modernize the experience for a new generation of players. By bringing these elements together, we create a more cohesive and accessible look that still feels true to the dark, atmospheric aesthetic of Arkham Horror. We want every player, old or new, to feel fully immersed in this world.”

虽然 Gamefound 和 FFG 本身的战役预览已经展示了《重制版》的一些更新视觉效果，但我们在 IGN 上独家与各位调查人员分享的这一作品的一个例子是“Tulzscha - 绿色火焰”，它是 Kingsport 扩展包的先驱之一。这幅艺术作品由艺术家彼得·波拉赫 (Peter Polach) 创作，描绘了神秘的邪教徒试图保护自己免受威胁的绿色火焰的侵害，他们被带到了图像的最前面，而不是背景中的小部分，但头骨和其他恐怖物品仍然清晰地显示在图尔兹查本身。

就承诺本身而言，虽然具体细节要等到发布后才能得知，但我们确实知道一些人可以期待什么，韦斯利表示：“我们将承诺选项设计得非常灵活，这样你就可以为你和你的朋友群体选择最好的体验。对于那些寻求完整体验的人来说，我们有一个捆绑选项，其中包括基础游戏和所有可用的扩展。”对于那些可能不想一次性全部投入的人来说，他们也为你提供了保障，“但对于那些可能更喜欢逐件构建自己的套装的人来说，你还可以承诺基础游戏，然后选择特定的扩展作为单独的附加组件。”
虽然《阿卡姆恐怖重制版》的大部分内容都让我感到兴奋，但作为拥有第二版原始版本的人，这是对现代桌面大众规则集的重新引入，我希望我可以用这些新重制版（并且更容易获得）选项来补充我缺失的扩展。不幸的是，对于那些抱有同样希望的人来说，有一些不幸的消息。
“虽然核心游戏玩法没有改变，但《阿卡姆恐怖》第二版的重制版使用了更新的图形设计和简化的卡牌文本。因此，游戏的两个版本彼此不兼容，”Dane 解释道。就像，我明白了，也许这是最好的选择，这样我就可以退役我那破旧的第二版，让它在我家里凉爽、干燥、黑暗的地方度过余下的辉煌岁月，但这并不意味着我不能有点沮丧，对吧？
《阿卡姆游戏》的明星之一是调查员——玩家扮演的角色——与我玩过的大多数人通常都有一个最喜欢的角色。对于我自己来说，我现在和永远都是一名 Dexter Drake 玩家。德雷克（Drake）是一位戴着杀手斗篷和高顶礼帽的魔术师（想想《美少女战士》中的燕尾服面具，但把面具换成杀手胡子，你就有了一个好主意）。借此机会，我想知道当古神发脾气时，韦斯利和戴恩会选择谁。

“戴安娜·斯坦利可能是我的首选。她实际上是我在游戏中挑选的第一批调查员之一，我和她在一起的经历非常难忘，以至于在那之后我每次都扮演她。”丹恩分享。 “这种最初的联系有一些东西真的让你难以忘怀。不过，如果我看看这些年来玩得最多的调查员，我倾向于利奥·安德森（Leo Anderson）、曼迪·汤普森（Mandy Thompson）和吉姆·卡尔弗（Jim Culver）。他们每个人都提供了一种不同的方式来解决阿卡姆的恐怖，这也是让游戏如此具有无限可重玩性的部分原因。”

items.title: 连性感红都感到困惑为什么暴风雨没有更多传奇皮肤
items.summary: Storm is one of a handful of female characters in Marvel Rivals with just one Legendary skin, and the pushback

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/sexyy-red-storm-marvel-rivals-1792444747028.jpg
Storm is one of a handful of female characters in Marvel Rivals with just one Legendary skin, and the pushback around this fact has become so great that even rapper Sexyy Red is speaking up about it.

Marvel Rivals published a statement to its official social media profiles on October 15 that outlined its plans to improve moderation regarding speech violations from players. And while this post sparked its own debate among the game’s fanbase, it prompted a request of a different kind from "Sticky" rapper Sexyy Red.
In a quote-retweet, Sexyy Red asked the official Marvel Rivals account when Storm is finally getting another Legendary skin, writing, “When y’all gon give Storm her legendary skin?”
When yal gon give storm her legendary skin??
Fans, of course, were mostly stunned that Sexyy Red plays Marvel Rivals, while others joined in on her request for more Storm costumes from the devs at NetEase and Marvel Games.

Both teams are well-aware of the discussion surrounding Storm’s Legendary skins (or lack thereof), as they directly acknowledged the matter in a post back in August. Players will likely remember this moment, as it came less than 24 hours after the debut of Storm’s swimsuit skin, Sacred Skies , which was listed as an Epic skin at the time.

Many fans expressed dismay that, out of all the other female characters included in the swimsuit lineup, Storm’s Sacred Skies skin was the only one that wasn’t a Legendary. Shortly afterwards, the Marvel Rivals Twitter/X account revealed its decision to upgrade the skin to a Legendary for free in direct response to player feedback.

“While we deeply value the expressive nature of our players, our number one goal is to create a positive community for everyone who loves this game,” they wrote. “...As the upgrades will take some time, please be patient, as we are already hard at work on the above. Get ready for the Mistress of the Elements to reign over the battlefield soon.”

This upgrade is still in the works, though fans are also looking forward to another Legendary skin coming Storm’s way, if rumors are to be believed. Based on character silhouettes for an upcoming skin line, it looks like players will soon get treated to some Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls crossover costumes, with game journalist Miller Ross comparing them to Storm and Iron Man’s poses in the 3v3 tag fighting game.

If true, this wouldn’t be the first time that a Marvel game has collaborated with Fighting Souls; Marvel’s Wolverine got its own cel-shaded skin directly from Arc System Works' fighting game, while Logan received a more realistic-looking costume in Fighting Souls from Insomniac’s action-adventure title.

It’s worth noting that Storm isn’t the only female character in Marvel Rivals to have just one Legendary skin; Jubilee, Black Widow, and Angela also only have one Legendary skin each. It seems like Emma Frost has the biggest wardrobe out of the entire lot — to the point where some fans are ready for her to share some closet space with the rest of the gals in the game.
Image Credits: Astrida Valigorsky/Getty Images

items.title: 《爱情》和《深空》推出《银翼杀手》联动版，粉丝们将其与取消的角色瓦尔科相提并论
items.summary: At first glance the Love and Deepspace Blade Runner 2049 crossover is a cool, if unexpected, addition to the o

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/edited-photo-1792443609711.jpg

At first glance the Love and Deepspace Blade Runner 2049 crossover is a cool, if unexpected, addition to the otome game's romantic universe, but it didn't take long for fans of the game to notice an uncomfortable parallel between one of the key storylines featuring the lead character's AI companion, Joi, and the canceled Love and Deepspace character Valko.
Warning: Blade Runner 2049 spoilers below!

In Blade Runner 2049, lead character K (Ryan Golsing) has a romantic relationship with an AI companion called Joi (played by Ana de Armas), but loses her when the "emanator" device that K uses that allows her to travel with him is destroyed. Love and Deepspace players immediately noted that something similar happened to the game's promised sixth love interest, Valko, a companion that players were already attached to when he was canceled by developer Infold just a week after his reveal following controversy around his character.

ironically, the bladerunner collab makes more sense like this, we lost valko just like the protagonist lost his virtual girlfriend joi, destroyed by the very same big corpo that created her, only for him to bump into that ad with another joi, naked and suggestive but not HIS joi

Other fans noted that a Blade Runner 2049 crossover, which is an unusual one for the universe, would have made sense as a vehicle for Valko, given that the character was described as a tech CEO and hacker.

Many are still hopeful that Valko could return, given the outpouring of support for the character on social media, at real-world events, and through boycotts, petitions, and charitable donations in his name. Players have sent money to wolf sanctuaries, sponsored forests, paid for billboards to feature him, and even set up memorials for the character. Infold has made no official comment about Valko since the initial cancellation.

The special event runs from today until November 5 and includes free in-game rewards inspired by the film. It's most likely part of a promotional campaign for the new Blade Runner 2099, which launches on Amazon Prime on November 25.

items.title: “没有人脑子里有这整件事”——GTA 6 开发者可以自由地添加很酷的功能，就像 RDR2 的马球一样
items.summary: Rockstar Games gave the GTA 6 developers so much freedom to add cool details that not even the studio's top ex

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/gta-6-soundtrack-1789662158949.jpg
Rockstar Games gave GTA 6 s' developers so much freedom to add cool details that not even the studio's top executives are aware of everything in the game.

The latest behind-the-scenes information on GTA 6 comes from Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, who expanded upon his trip to the Rockstar North offices in Edinburgh, Scotland, after previously sharing other highlights last week . One of the more noteworthy bits shared in his 18-minute video's runtime is that the team who spent a decade or so making next month's Grand Theft Auto game had quite a bit of freedom to add details simply because they thought they might be cool.

Schreier said he'd guess that "not even top developers" at Rockstar know every tiny detail added to Vice City and its wealth of NPCs. He noted that giving large teams the autonomy to flesh out every street corner isn't too uncommon for open-world games. In the case of GTA 6 and its huge budget and lengthy development time, that means players will likely still be discovering new details even years down the road.

Schreier shared a quote from Rockstar's Aaron Garbut, who said, "There's no one person that has this whole thing in their head." That's probably not too new for the GTA team, with the video also recalling one specific detail from Red Dead Redemption 2 .

Players may remember that horses found through the cowboy simulator had testicles with realistic physics. The thing fans still love to pass around to this day is the fact that they even shrink in colder weather.

Garbut mentioned that this specific feature (if you can call it that) was not something Rockstar had on some big list of details to include in Red Dead Redemption 2, nor was it something the team was ever asked to spend extra time on. Instead, the shrinking horse testicles, like many other details in the 2018 Western sandbox game, was something that someone happened to have enough time to work on and bring to life. It's this same strategy that fans can expect to see implemented in GTA 6.

Schreier's video also revealed that Rockstar spent quite a bit of time trying to do away with the weapon wheel it had leaned on in past games. Worried that slapping a game-y wheel on Jason and Lucia would remind players of what they can't carry on their person, they attempted to create a new system to replace it. The team then spent "months, if not years, trying a million different things." Examples listed include trays, webs, and UI updates for the formula before eventually, as we've seen , tossing all of those ideas out the window and going back to the traditional weapon wheel.

Meanwhile, as one might imagine could be the case over the course of developing a major video game, Rockstar's long path to launch wasn't without its roadblocks. Schreier said the "dark moments" of development saw the GTA 6 team struggle between the years of about 2019 to 2022. He said Rockstar's desire to balance the realism of Red Dead Redemption gameplay with the traditionally more arcade-y systems GTA is known for was the driving factor.

It was during this time that some team members felt they were just "treading water," leading the project to shed some designers before the vision really started coming together toward the beginning of 2023. According to Schreier's reporting, some Rockstar artists have been working on GTA 6 since 2015, just two years after the launch of GTA 5. It was this same year the team started taking trips to Miami to plot out their reimagined Vice City.

Now, after all this time, GTA 6 is exactly one month away (!) from its November 19, 2026, release date. To help hype up everyone who has waited 13 years to see if it was worth the long, long wait, Rockstar has taken over Miami. One recent example from its marketing push includes a collection of cars ripped straight out of the game .

For more, you can check out new details and screenshots from the GTA 6 launch trailer . Rockstar has insisted it won't take another eight years to make its next game , but as we wait during these last 30 days for this one, you can read IGN's interview with Rob Nelson .

本作会在流程较早阶段开放盖亚世界。克劳德一行取得飞空艇后，便可前往部分高难度战斗地点，即使当时尚未做好迎战准备也不会受到限制。这种探索结构也促使团队调整原有的难度方案。

《最终幻想7：启示》将于2027年4月8日发售，登陆PC、PS5、XSX/S和Switch2。

items.summary: 近日《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》开发团队说明了重制1996年初代作品时的取舍：新版将尽量保留承载玩家情感记忆的场面与空间，同时改造不符合现代呈现标准或内部逻辑的细节，而非逐项照搬原作。Flying Wild Hog创意总

content.v: 近日《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》开发团队说明了重制1996年初代作品时的取舍：新版将尽量保留承载玩家情感记忆的场面与空间，同时改造不符合现代呈现标准或内部逻辑的细节，而非逐项照搬原作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792443029_235015_jpg_r.jpg
Flying Wild Hog创意总监Michał Kuk表示，玩家通关后闭上眼睛回想原作，最容易留下的通常是情绪冲击强烈的时刻，以及与之相连的地点、景观和物件。团队认为，这些构成集体记忆的内容在新版中应当近乎不作改动，但整体仍会以经典故事和氛围为基础，创造有所差异的体验。
这种路线更接近《生化危机》和《最终幻想7》的重制思路，与强调忠实还原的《合金装备Δ：食蛇者》和《塞尔达传说：织梦岛》有所不同。部分玩家已经批评新版加入现代AAA游戏常见的制作系统和技能树，而这些机制也曾出现在《古墓丽影》“幸存者”三部曲中。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261006/1791234856_367366_jpg_r.jpg
Crystal Dynamics体验总监Jeff Adams解释，画面和世界越写实，原作中的部分安排就越难自圆其说。他举例称，在封闭一万年的古墓中找到医疗包并不合理，即使同一场景还包含持枪对抗 恐龙 的内容。团队希望借此维持系列身份，同时避免把新版做成对旧作的逐帧复制。

items.title: Xbox 业务人员在表示不拥抱人工智能的游戏开发者“不应该从事商业业务”后不到 24 小时就删除了他的 X 帐户
items.summary: Business strategy manager Brandon Stirrup said he was "happy to take the hit" for his stance on AI, then left

content.v: Xbox senior business strategy manager Brandon Stirrup is tired of pussyfooting around about AI: In a thread on X his week, he said that he wants the world to know that Xbox uses it, that he thinks everyone should be using it, and that he believes so strongly in the cause that he's willing to "take the hit" for saying so.
He has since deleted his X account. A source at Xbox tells PC Gamer that Stirrup opted to deactivate the account because of the volume of replies he was receiving.

Stirrup kicked off his thread on October 18 with a simple message saying he'd "vibe coded a bad but improvable game" over two days, although he only "actively" worked on it for about three hours. "I’m telling you I tried it and it’s true…anyone can build a game."
After saying that developers and studios who aren't incorporating AI into their strategies are "planning for a fake future," Stirrup went all in.

"Look if I'm fired tomorrow it will be because I told you the truth that nobody wants you to know. You can make a game with a simple prompt and yes you can make custom, tailored games. Everything you want in a game is right there for the taking, for better or worse," he wrote.
"I'm happy to take the hit if it means hundreds at Xbox can stop pretending that they're not using AI. It's time to accept and move forward."

After calling out the game industry and gamers alike for their reluctance to accept "reality," Stirrup stated explicitly that Xbox is "using AI" and then added, "My goal is to get this over with so we can move on as a company, despite the fact that some will persecute me for this: we use AI, just as all companies do in 2026."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PAmZ8zuigfcxi3fTpPXctP-1920-80.jpg

There's a growing push for people to simply accept the "reality" of AI: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, for instance, recently said the studio was "moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration," after which the Epic Games Store ignited a firestorm by saying it " vibe coded " its new launcher. Xbox, now under the leadership of a former AI executive, recently launched a new Xbox Labs program to pursue emerging technologies, which naturally includes AI; even Linux recently dropped its rule requiring AI usage disclosures .
Stirrup himself is an enthusiastic AI evangelist: Last month, he also counselled laid-off employees to use Copilot to catalog their skills and accomplishments at the company.

items.title: 魔兽世界：永远在翱翔，但午夜在挣扎
items.summary: World of Warcraft : Forever is riding high thanks to its popular beta and upcoming launch, but retail WoW's Mi

content.v: World of Warcraft : Forever is riding high thanks to its popular beta and upcoming launch, but retail WoW's Midnight expansion feels like it's in a state of crisis by comparison.

The two different versions of WoW couldn't be in more different places. Forever seems to be extremely popular, with Blizzard developers commenting how its beta is breaking records . Blizzard itself has also been more communicative regarding Forever than ever before, with weekly podcasts diving into community topics, forum posts addressing various issues, and frequent updates addressing balance problems and bugs.

Midnight seems to be in the opposite corner. Its latest content update, patch 12.1.5, went live October 13. In addition to new story quests that continue the expansion's main narrative, it added a new single-boss raid and a long-teased mega delve (officially called a labyrinth) that gives solo-focused players an almost raid-like experience.

Unfortunately, the patch was released in a bug-riddled state. The Kindo'jan labyrinth, arguably the patch's biggest feature, saw players running into issue after issue. Some players complained about not earning credit for boss kills and being unable to collect rewards. One particularly nasty bug had players falling through the floor of the labyrinth's final boss arena, making it so the labyrinth couldn't be completed. Other players cited issues with delve companion Valeera dying too quickly or failing to do proper boss mechanics.

Many of the most glaring bugs (like falling through the floor) were fixed in a hotfix deployed on October 16, but labyrinths still have a major issue: no save points . When Blizzard first detailed labyrinths, it implied players would be able to start one, make some progress, and come back to finish it at a later time. Blizzard's exact wording was that players would be able to "venture through them in a single epic session or tackle them piece by piece over time, progressing at your own pace."

That currently isn't true, as the labyrinth has no checkpoints and must be completed in a single session. Labyrinths taking at least an hour or so to complete, combined with various bugs preventing progress and no way to save and come back to them later, is making for an incredibly frustrating experience. It's unclear if the lack of checkpoints is a bug, an unannounced change on Blizzard's part, or just some kind of oversight, but it's not a great debut for Midnight's newest feature.
Story spoilers for WoW: Midnight patch 12.1.5 below.

Bugs and issues surrounding labyrinths are just one part of why patch 12.1.5 has proven unpopular. The patch is also catching flak for its story, specifically how it killed off a major character unceremoniously. Liadrin, a blood elf paladin and one of the main characters players have interacted with over the course of Midnight, dies facing off against Kithix, the resurrected Old God general that serves at the patch's new raid encounter.

However, she doesn't die in any kind of epic or heroic way. Instead, judging from the post-raid cinematic, she dies from what seems to be exhaustion, having wielded the power of the light too strongly in the battle against Kithix. After Kithix's defeat, Liadrin utters "Darkness will never prevail" before crumpling to the ground and dying.

WoW is not a stranger to having major characters die. It famously happened with Varyian Wrynn, the leader of the Alliance, during the start of the game's Legion expansion. But unlike Varyian's epic death, Liadrin's feels anticlimactic. The fact that it occurs during a .5 patch that feels disconnected to the game's larger narrative makes the story beat feel unnecessary.

Adding salt to the wound is that her death looks to be in service of a recurring and unpopular trend in recent WoW storylines where old rivalries and feuds between factions are easily reconciled. In Liadrin's case, her death brings together the blood elves and the Amani trolls, though Blizzard does make a point in a post-raid quest to emphasise the two groups are not allies despite now being at peace. Blizzard may have said its putting the "war" back in Warcraft during BlizzCon 2026, but all of its recent story beats have seen ancient enemies coming together and cooperating, and Liadrin's death only serves to reinforce that.

This isn't the first time a .5 patch has been met with negative reception from WoW's players. It was only back in April that Blizzard released patch 12.0.5 in an extremely buggy state . Player outcry saw Blizzard go as far to issue a public apology , stating it was "taking lessons learned from this launch to help ensure this doesn't happen again," and that "we will do better." Flash forward six months later, and it doesn't seem like much has changed.

That puts Midnight in a weird place overall. Blizzard barely talked about modern WoW at this year's BlizzCon. It teased Midnight's final content patch that will see players finally confront Xal'atath once and for all, but didn't share more details about what to expect from the game's next expansion, The Last Titan, despite it being slated to release next year.

Instead, Blizzard put almost all its emphasis on WoW: Forever, a new, WoW Classic-inspired version of Blizzard's MMORPG that adds new content and visual upgrades to the old-school version of Azeroth. In an interview with GameSpot, Blizzard shared more details on what to expect from WoW: Forever's future and its endgame. WoW: Forever launches November 4.

items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases this week, and with gaming consoles and capable PC rigs now more expen

content.v: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases this week, and with gaming consoles and capable PC rigs now more expensive than ever, you might be wondering if there is another way to play.
Thankfully, there is, but there are a few things you need to know before jumping in.
How to play MW4 without a console or PC
With Game Pass:
Modern Warfare 4 is not included with Xbox Game Pass this year, but if you're a subscriber you can leverage the "stream your own game" program to play it that way, after purchasing it outright.
This isn't locked away to any specific tier of Game Pass, either. You can subscribe to Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate to stream MW4.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/COD1_98947f.jpg?w=636
With GeForce Now:

Nvidia's streaming service, GeForce Now, will be another way to play Modern Warfare 4 without any expensive hardware like a new console or high-end PC. Or at least we think so. Nvidia hasn't outright confirmed this, but people are playing the campaign early access via GeForce Now , so it stands to reason that it will be officially supported at launch for everyone.
After buying the game outright, you'll be able to stream MW4 on GeForce Now by subscribing to one of the platform's membership tiers.

GeForce Now has multiple tiers, including a free ad-supported membership. There are also $10/month and $20/month tiers with no ads and higher-fidelity experiences. There are also day passes available.
For more, check out the GeForce Now website .
Pros and cons of streaming

Before subscribing to Game Pass or GeForce Now, people should know that playing a twitch shooter like Modern Warfare 4 over the internet might not always be the perfect experience. After all, a cloud service works best with a strong and stable connection, and that's not always a guarantee. However, many people report good experiences, and as always, your mileage may vary.
Something else to consider is that, starting in November, Microsoft will implement caps on how many hours people can stream via Game Pass before they must pay more to keep playing.

The benefits of streaming are pretty obvious: You don't need any expensive hardware. This is because a game is streamed on high-end hardware and beamed to your screen, whatever that may be. You will still need a controller or a keyboard and mouse setup, but you might have those things already, and if you don't, they cost significantly less than a new console or a powerful PC.
Why are consoles and PCs so expensive today?

The Xbox Series X|S and PS5 consoles were released in 2020, but today, six years later, they are more expensive than ever. Historically, console prices come down instead of going up. So what's driving the price increases? The AI-fueled demand for components and memory is to blame, as is the war in Iran that's driving up oil prices. There are numerous other macroeconomic factors at play, too, including tariffs.

Companies like Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo want to keep making money in this environment. Instead of eating the costs (while they make huge profits and collect tariff refunds), they are charging people more to maintain their margins.

The Switch 2 is among the cheapest ways to play MW4 this year, with that console starting at $500 (up from $450 at launch). The PS5 now starts at $600 (up from $400 at launch) and the latest Xbox consoles are more expensive, too. The Series S now goes for $500 (was $300) and Series X for $750 ($500 at launch). In short, you're in for major sticker shock if you're buying a new console.
For PC players, it's more expensive than ever to build a capable rig, but your price will vary depending on the setup you want, preconfigured or made yourself.
For more, check out GameSpot's Modern Warfare 4 campaign review , and keep checking back for more coverage on DMZ and multiplayer when the game goes live on October 23.

items.title: 价值超过 10 万美元的分级交易卡从联邦快递卡车被盗后，PSA 做出回应
items.summary: Hundreds of PSA-graded trading cards worth more than $100,000 were reportedly stolen from a FedEx truck over t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/hundreds-of-psa-graded-trading-cards-stolen-from-fedex-truck-1792435194146.jpg
Hundreds of PSA-graded trading cards worth more than $100,000 were reportedly stolen from a FedEx truck over the weekend, leaving collectors distraught — and the damage is still being calculated.

On October 17, a collector named SKY-B posted on Twitter/X claiming that PSA had notified him via email that a FedEx truck carrying his 104-card collection had been burglarized after leaving its Southern California location. According to SKY-B, more than $100,000 worth of cards had been taken.

In its email, which SKY-B shared in a reply , PSA outlined steps it had taken to rectify the situation as best as possible, saying it had deactivated certificates for the affected items, notified its commerce partners of the stolen cards, and is actively working with both FedEx and law enforcement to investigate the theft.

"We will compensate you for the items from your order that were involved, which is based on fair market value up to the Maximum Insured Value ("MIV") you selected for each item." @natsturner, I pray you handle this and take care of everyone affected in the most professional manner possible. I have an awful feeling PSA is going to be extremely unfair on what the values of these cards are.

PSA also stated that it would compensate SKY-B for the items in his collection, the monetary amount for which is “based on fair market value up to the Maximum Insured Value" he selected for each item.

In a YouTube video , SKY-B explained that the stolen order had taken him more than two years to accumulate, which included “many irreplaceable cards” that he fears he’ll never see again. He said that he hand-delivered the cards to PSA to be graded at the National Card Show in July, and three months later, his extensive collection could be lining the pockets of the thieves who stole it.

SKY-B says he spent $8,000 to have the cards graded, which had a maximum insurance value of $156,000 each. The collector claimed that several of the cards in his collection exceeded this maximum value, but says that he wasn’t “upcharged” by PSA because of this — making him worry that the company will “destroy” him with “low-ball values” of all his cards.

“Honestly, that’s what hurts the most, outside of obviously being absolutely financially destroyed here,” he said, referring to likely never seeing his carefully-curated collection again. “...I am currently out all of the money that it cost to acquire these cards, I’m out all the PSA grading fees, and I don’t have and I probably will never see any of these cards in person.”

SKY-B wasn’t the only one impacted by the FedEx truck theft; content creator and fellow collector Boston Card Hunter claimed that he was approached by a “major PSA dealer” who told him that customers had lost an estimated “$500K of declared value.”

After speaking with other affected dealers and collectors, Boston Card Hunter stated that FedEx trucks have now become targets for thieves, and speculated that dealers might handle their own shipping and handling from PSA moving forward.

Currently, Boston Card Hunter has compiled a list of 383 serialized cards that were allegedly stolen from this FedEx truck, which include a 1995 Upper Deck 23K Gold Michael Jordan 50,000 Print Run, a 2024 One Piece Simplified Chinese 1st Anniversary Set Nami, and many other cards from various anime series, trading card games, and sports figures.
Over on Reddit , other card collectors claimed to have also been victims of the FedEx theft, with one saying their PSA 9 Smaug the Magnificent card from Magic: The Gathering had been burgled.

In a statement to IGN, PSA reiterated the steps it has taken to help law enforcement and FedEx recover the items and investigate the theft, as well as contacting customers to compensate them based on fair market value.
PSA's full statement is as follows:
"We are aware of a theft involving a third-party shipping vehicle carrying PSA-graded items. We are working closely with law enforcement and the carrier as the investigation continues.

"We have deactivated the certificates for the stolen items and notified marketplace partners so they can be on the lookout for rare and serialized items. Our customer service team has contacted affected customers directly and is arranging compensation based on fair market value.

"We understand the impact this has on collectors involved, many of whom see these cards as far more than a financial asset. Our team is focused on supporting them. We take this incident seriously, and we will continue working with law enforcement to hold those responsible accountable."

This is the latest development to go viral within the card collecting community after Pokemon TCG collectors were put on blast for offering to trade their purebred puppies in exchange for cards at two separate card shows.
Image Credits: Marcin Golba/NurPhoto via Getty Images

items.summary: British actor Rahul Kohli (Saros, Midnight Mass) has a pitch for a new L.A. Noire game, and it sounds pretty g

content.v: British actor Rahul Kohli (Saros, Midnight Mass) has a pitch for a new L.A. Noire game, and it sounds pretty great. Speaking to BAFTA Games , Kohli said he would like to see the franchise return with a spinoff that takes players through different time periods, as a cop, as they investigate different crimes.

One such setting could be Victorian England, with a storyline focused on hunting down Jack the Ripper, Kohli said. Another could take players to the '80s in California as they pursue the Night Stalker, the actor added.
"We could jump around and be a cop in different times. I would be down for that," Kohli said. "I loved it. I adored L.A. Noire."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/LANoire_ece858.jpg?w=636

In particular, Kohli said he was a big fan of developer Team Bondi's facial-capture system which created lifelike expressions in the game, down to granular details like how a person’s eyebrows might move.

In a game where players had to read people's facial expressions, this was a big deal, and one can only imagine how much further the technology could go today. However, Kohli said he wants a new L.A. Noire game with the same tech and the same engine.
"I want that. I don't want an improvement to it. That was part of the charm," he said.
L.A. Noire was released in 2011. It never got a sequel, and its developer, Team Bondi, later disbanded. A virtual reality game, L.A. Noire: The VR Case Files, was released in 2017.
Earlier this year, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said the company was looking at future projects in all of its franchises , and that includes L.A. Noire.

Back in 2012, Rockstar said a sequel to L.A. Noire was a “possibility.” At the time, the developer said, “We don’t always rush to make sequels, but that does not mean we won’t get to them eventually. We have so many games we want to make, and the issue is always one of bandwidth and timing.”
Recently, a rumor emerged that a new L.A. Noire game is now in the works, and it will have players collecting clues to try to find the Zodiac Killer .
